settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: Exercises stay in the language of the textbook.
settings.motionHelp: Countdowns stay animated: they carry information.

settings.branchKeyHelp: Links the branch to the curriculum. Chosen once, never changed.

settings.newSchoolHelp: You become a member immediately. Your session stays on the current establishment: switch from the rail when you are ready.
